Rashi on Eruvin 11a:10:1.hebrew: שרובן ס"ד - כיון דרובן פתחים וחלונות, הוה ליה פרוץ מרובה, והיכי מצי תו למיתני ובלבד שיהא עומד מרובה:
Rashi on Eruvin 11a:10:1.english: Could it enter your mind that most of them - Since most of them are entrances and windows, it is [a case where the] breached [portion is] greater [than the standing portion], and how can it further teach: "Provided that the standing [portion] is greater"?

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:10:2.hebrew: אלא שריבה בהן - שעשה בהן הרבה פתחים וחלונות סביב סביב, מותר, ובלבד שיהא בין פתח לפתח יותר מכדי פתח. אלמא עומד מרובה על הפרוץ בעינן, ואע"ג דאיכא צורת פתח בכולהו:
Rashi on Eruvin 11a:10:2.english: Rather, that he made many in them - That he made in them many entrances and windows all around, [it is] permitted, provided that there is between [each] entrance and [the next] entrance more than the width of an entrance. Evidently, we require that the standing [portion] be greater than the breached [portion], even though there is the form of a doorway in all of them.

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:11:1.hebrew: פיתחי שימאי - פתחין שוממין. ל"א: פתחים מקולקלין שמחוסרין תיקון, כמו זקן אשמאי, חסר מתורה:
Rashi on Eruvin 11a:11:1.english: Broken entrances [pitḥei shima’ei] - Desolate entrances. Another explanation: Defective entrances that lack completion, like an ignorant elder [zaken ashmai], [who is] lacking in Torah.

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:12:1.hebrew: שיקפי - מזוזות שנחלצו אבניהם מכאן ומכאן, אבן יוצאת ואבן נכנסת, ואין זו צורת פתח:
Rashi on Eruvin 11a:12:1.english: Jagged stones [or recesses] - Doorposts whose stones were dislodged from here and from there, [such that] one stone projects and one stone recedes, and this is not the form of a doorway.

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:12:2.hebrew: תיקרה - שאין כלום בנין למעלה מן הפתח, אלא כל הכותל חלוק כפתח עד ראשו, כזה (*):(*). וצורת פתח שאמרו: קנה מכאן וקנה מכאן, וקנה על גביהן:
Rashi on Eruvin 11a:12:2.english: A ceiling - That there is no construction at all above the entrance, but rather the entire wall is divided like an opening all the way to its top, like this (*):(*). And the form of an entrance of which they spoke [is] a reed on this side, a reed on that side, and a reed on top of them.

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:13:1.english: Holds that [opinion] of Rav - That the form of a doorway is not effective for more than ten [cubits] in an alleyway.

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:13:2.english: Beit Ḥarvatan - The name of a place.

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:13:3.english: And stretched a vine over them - From one [pole] to the other, in the manner of the form of a doorway.

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:13:4.hebrew: לענין כלאים - שאם יש גפנים בתוך הקונדסין, מותר לזרוע סמוך להן חוץ למחיצה, כדתנן: היה גדר בינתים, זה סומך לגדר מכאן וזה סומך לגדר מכאן:
Rashi on Eruvin 11a:13:4.english: With regard to diverse kinds - That if there are grapevines within the poles, it is permitted to sow close to them outside the partition, as we learned in a Mishna: "If there was a fence between them, this one may sow close to the fence on this side, and that one may sow close to the fence on that side."

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:14:1.english: Regarding Shabbat - To carry within it.

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:15:1.hebrew: מן הצד - שמתח הזמורה מזה לזה באמצעיתו, ולא על ראשיהן:
Rashi on Eruvin 11a:15:1.english: From the side - That he stretched the vine branch from this [reed] to that [reed] at its middle, and not on top of them.

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:15:2.hebrew: לא עשה כלום - ולענין שבת, אמאי התירו לו:
Rashi on Eruvin 11a:15:2.english: He has done nothing - And regarding Shabbat, why did they permit it to him?

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:16:1.english: With regard to Shabbat, no - Behold, [with an opening] of ten [cubits], everyone agrees that it is an entrance.

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:18:1.hebrew: ובדרב חסדא פליגי - ריש לקיש לית ליה דרב חסדא, ור' יוחנן אית ליה דרב חסדא, וקסבר: כי אמר רב חסדא — לשבת, אבל לכלאים, אפילו מן הצד הוי צורת פתח, דשבת חמור מכלאים:
Rashi on Eruvin 11a:18:1.english: And they disagree with regard to [the statement of] Rav Ḥisda - Reish Lakish does not accept [the ruling of] Rav Ḥisda, and Rabbi Yoḥanan accepts [the ruling of] Rav Ḥisda, and he maintains: When Rav Ḥisda said [his ruling, he meant only] with regard to Shabbat; but with regard to diverse kinds, even [if made] from the side, it constitutes [a valid] form of a doorway, for Shabbat is more stringent than diverse kinds.

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:5:1.english: Teach him: He must diminish - Even if it has the form of a doorway.

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:6:1.hebrew: מדברי רבינו - רב, דאמר צורת פתח לא מהניא:
Rashi on Eruvin 11a:6:1.english: From the words of our teacher - Rav, who said that the form of a doorway is not effective.

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:6:2.english: Whose majority is entrances - In its four walls.

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:6:3.hebrew: אינה ניתרת בצורת פתח - ואפילו פתחים קטנים מעשר, כי היכי דלא מהניא צורת פתח לשוויה יותר מעשר פתחא, לא מהני נמי לפרוץ מרובה על העומד בפתחים קטנים:
Rashi on Eruvin 11a:6:3.english: It is not permitted by the form of a doorway - And even [with] entrances smaller than ten [cubits]: Just as the form of a doorway is not effective to make [an opening of] more than ten [cubits] into an entrance, it is also not effective for [a case where the] breached [portion] is greater than the standing [portion], with small entrances.

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:8:1.hebrew: מה ליותר מעשר - דין הוא שלא יועיל צורת פתח בו, שכן חמור איסורו, שלא הותר בשום מקום בשבת, ואפילו בפסי ביראות, ואליבא דר' מאיר, דאמר בפ' שני (לקמן עירובין יז:) וביניהן כמלא שתי רבקות של ג' ג' בקר, דהיינו עשר אמות, דכל פרה אמה ושני שלישי אמה:
Rashi on Eruvin 11a:8:1.english: What [basis of comparison is there] to [an opening of] more than ten - It is logical that the form of a doorway should not be effective for it, for its prohibition is stringent, as it was not permitted anywhere on Shabbat, and even regarding upright boards around wells, in accordance with Rabbi Meir, who said in the second chapter (below, Eruvin 17b): "And between them, as much as the space of two teams of three cattle each," which is ten cubits, since each cow is a cubit and two-thirds of a cubit.

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:8:2.hebrew: תאמר בפרוץ מרובה על העומד - בפרצות של עשר או פחות, שהרי הותר בפסי ביראות, ואפילו לרבי מאיר, דמחמיר בהו ואסר ביותר מעשר, מיהו פרוץ מרובה מודי דשרי, וכ"ש לר' יהודה, דמכשיר בי"ג אמה ושליש:
Rashi on Eruvin 11a:8:2.english: Can you say [the same] of [a case where the] breached [segment] is greater than the standing [segment] - [This refers to] breaches of ten [cubits] or less, for it was permitted regarding the upright boards around wells, and even according to Rabbi Meir, who is stringent regarding them and forbade [an opening of] more than ten [cubits]. Nevertheless, [where the] breached [part] is greater [than the standing part], he agrees that it is permitted, and all the more so according to Rabbi Yehuda, who permits [a breach of up to] thirteen and a third cubits.

Rashi on Eruvin 11a:9:1.english: Let us say [this] supports him - To the one who says that the form of a doorway is not effective when the standing [portion] is less than the breached [portion].

Tosafot on Eruvin 11a:12:1.hebrew: פתחי שימאי - פר"ח: פתחי ארץ ישראל, שהוא ארץ בני שם:
Tosafot on Eruvin 11a:12:1.english: Broken entrances - Rabbeinu Chananel explained: Entrances of the Land of Israel, which is the land of the children of Shem.

Tosafot on Eruvin 11a:16:1.hebrew: אילימא בעשר בהא לימא ר' יוחנן בשבת לא - אין להקשות: דמאי פריך, דילמא סבר כנהרדעא דאצרכוהו דלתות אפילו בעשר, דביתר מעשר שמואל נמי מודה דהוי כמפולש? דכאן איירי בבקעה שהיא כרמלית, דליכא מאן דפליג שלא יועיל צורת הפתח, כדאמרינן לעיל (עירובין ד' ז.). אך קשה: דהא רב יוסף אסר לעיל אפילו בעשר, הואיל ופרוץ מרובה; ואפילו בכלה לבקעה איירי, דומיא דיתר מעשר דאסר ואפילו בכלה לבקעה, מדמייתי מרבי יוחנן דאיירי בבקעה. א"כ, מה פריך בהא לימא ר' יוחנן, כיון דרב יוסף סבר הכי? וי"ל: דאין לחוש לדברי רב יוסף, הואיל ונדחו. וא"ת: הואיל ומהני צורת הפתח מכל ד' רוחות, א"כ גבי פסי ביראות למה הוצרכו לארבעה דיומדין, ולא הוי שרי אלא לבהמה, בין לר"מ ובין לר' יהודה? היה להם לעשות ד' קונדסין וזמורה על גביהן — לרב בעשר, ולמתני' ביתר מעשר! וגבי שיירא נמי, אמאי צריך שלשה חבלים זה למעלה מזה, או קנים פחות פחות מג'? יעשו צורת הפתח מד' רוחות! ואומר ר"י: לפי שלא היה מתקיים כל כך, משום דאתו גמלי ושדו ליה; וגם בקל יכול ליפול ברוח שאינה מצויה, לפי שהיו צריכין להגביהו מן הגמלים הנכנסים שם לשתות, וכן בשיירא. ועוד, דבשיירא אין להתיר כמו בחצר שמוקף לדירה. וריצב"א מפרש: דהכא לא איירי בד' דפנות, וה"פ, "כך התירו לענין שבת" — במפולש, דהיינו ב' מחיצות, דב' מחיצות לענין שבת הוי כד' מחיצות לענין כלאים, דבכלאים אין חילוק בין ב' לד'. והשתא פריך שפיר: בהא לימא רבי יוחנן בשבת לא? דבב' מחיצות אין לחוש אם פרוץ מרובה. והשר מקוצי מפרש, דהכי פירושא: בהא לימא רבי יוחנן בשבת לא — אי לית ליה דרב, דאמר ביתר מעשר לא מהני צורת הפתח? דהא דאמר רב יוסף: צורת הפתח לא מהניא בפרוץ מרובה, היינו מדברי רב דאסר ביתר מעשר. אלא לאו ביתר מעשר, ס"ל לרבי יוחנן כרב דלא מהני צורת הפתח; ולכך אפילו בעשר קאמר רבי יוחנן בשבת דלא מהני צורת הפתח, משום דפרוץ מרובה לרב יוסף אסור אפילו ע"י צורת הפתח, דאית ליה בנין אב:
Tosafot on Eruvin 11a:16:1.english: If we say [the opening was] ten [cubits], in this [case] would Rabbi Yoḥanan say, with regard to Shabbat, no - One should not ask: Why does [the Gemara] object [to this]? Perhaps [Rabbi Yoḥanan] holds like Neharde'a, who required doors even at ten [cubits] — for regarding [an opening of] more than ten [cubits], Shmuel also concedes that it is considered like [an alleyway] open on both ends [mefulash]? For here we are dealing with a valley [bik'ah], which is a karmelit, where there is no one who disputes that the form of a doorway [tzurat hapetach] is effective, as we said above (Eruvin 7a). However, it is difficult: For behold, Rav Yosef prohibited above even at ten [cubits], since the breached [portion] is greater [than the standing wall]; and [his ruling] deals even where it terminates at a valley, similar to [an opening of] more than ten [cubits] which he prohibited even where it terminates at a valley, since [the Gemara] cites [a challenge] from Rabbi Yoḥanan, who deals with a valley. If so, why does [the Gemara] object: "In this [case] would Rabbi Yoḥanan say [with regard to Shabbat, no]?" — since Rav Yosef holds this way! And one can answer: One need not be concerned with the words of Rav Yosef, since they were refuted. And if you should say: Since the form of a doorway is effective on all four sides, if so, regarding the enclosure boards of cisterns [pasei biraot], why did they require four corner posts [diyomedin], and [even then] it was permitted only for an animal, according to both Rabbi Meir and Rabbi Yehudah? They should have made four poles with a vine on top of them — according to Rav, at ten [cubits apart], and according to the Mishnah, at more than ten [cubits apart]! And regarding a caravan [sheyarah] as well, why is it necessary [to have] three ropes one above the other, or reeds [separated by] less than three [tefachim]? Let them make the form of a doorway on all four sides! And the Ri says: Because it would not endure so [well], since camels would come and knock it down; and it could also easily fall in an unusual wind, because they needed to elevate it [to keep it safe] from the camels that enter there to drink; and likewise regarding a caravan. Furthermore, in a caravan, one should not permit [an enclosure] like in a courtyard, which is enclosed for dwelling. And the Ritzba explains that here [the Gemara] is not dealing with four walls, and this is its explanation: "So they permitted with regard to Shabbat" — [this refers to an alleyway that is] open on both ends [mefulash], that is, [having] two walls; for two walls with regard to Shabbat are like four walls with regard to Kilayim, since with regard to Kilayim there is no difference between two [walls] and four. And now [the Gemara] objects well: "In this [case] would Rabbi Yoḥanan say [with regard to] Shabbat, no?" — for with two walls, one need not be concerned if the breached [portion] is greater [than the standing portion]. And the Sar of Coucy explains that this is the explanation: "In this [case] would Rabbi Yoḥanan say [with regard to] Shabbat, no?" — if he does not hold [in accordance with the ruling] of Rav, who said [that] at more than ten [cubits] the form of a doorway is not effective? For that which Rav Yosef said, that the form of a doorway is not effective where the breached [portion] is greater, was [derived] from the words of Rav who prohibited at more than ten [cubits]. Rather, is it not [that] at more than ten [cubits], Rabbi Yoḥanan holds like Rav that the form of a doorway is not effective? And for this reason, even at ten [cubits], Rabbi Yoḥanan said [that] regarding Shabbat the form of a doorway is not effective, because [where] the breached [portion] is greater, according to Rav Yosef it is prohibited even by means of the form of a doorway, since he possesses a paradigm [binyan av, from Rav's ruling].

Tosafot on Eruvin 11a:1:1.hebrew: איפכא מאי - כלומר, מי מהניא צורת הפתח בגובהה? וקשיא לר"ת, דהא צורת הפתח הוי קנה מכאן וקנה מכאן וקנה על גביהן; דל קנה דעל גביהן, ליתכשר בקנה דמכאן ומכאן, דהוי כלחי משהו! וי"ל, דמיבעיא ליה היכא דלא מהני לחי, כמו במפולש, או ביתר מעשר דבעי צורת הפתח, או לר' יוסי דבעי לחי רוחב ג'. ובהכי מיתוקמא נמי ברייתא דמייתי:
Tosafot on Eruvin 11a:1:1.english: What is the opposite? - That is to say: Does the form of a doorway [tzurat hapetach] help regarding [excessive] height? And Rabbeinu Tam raised a difficulty: For behold, the form of a doorway consists of a reed on this side, a reed on that side, and a reed on top of them. Disregard the reed that is on top of them — let [the alleyway] be rendered permissible by the reed on this side and on that side, which serves as a minimal sidepost [lechi]! And it can be answered that he is inquiring about [a case] where a sidepost is not effective, such as in an open-ended alleyway [mefulash], or [where the entrance is] wider than ten [cubits], which requires the form of a doorway, or according to Rabbi Yosei, who requires a sidepost to have a width of three [handbreadths]. And in this manner, the baraita that [the Gemara] brings is also established.

Tosafot on Eruvin 11a:6:1.hebrew: חצר שרובה פתחים וחלונות - ובפחות מעשר, דאי ביתר מעשר, אפילו בעומד מרובה, הא אתנייה רב: צריך למעט. ובד' דפנותיה איירי, דמשני צדדין מודה רב דמהני צורת הפתח, דאמרינן לעיל הלכה כת"ק. וקשיא: דמהאי בנין אב, אפילו מחיצה רביעית יש ללמוד דלא מהני צורת הפתח, כי היכי דלא מהני ביתר מעשר אפילו במחיצה אחת! וי"ל, דאין ללמוד אלא על ד' מחיצות, דמחיצה אחת ביתר מעשר הוי כמו פרוץ מרובה בד' מחיצות: דמה שאוסר ביתר מעשר משום דלא מיקרי פתח ולא מהני ליה צורת הפתח, גם לפרוץ מרובה מד' רוחות לא יועיל צורת הפתח, דפתחא בד' רוחות לא עבדי אינשי; אבל אמחיצה אחת, דעבדי פתח, פשיטא דמהני צורת הפתח, ועל זה אין שייך ללמוד:
Tosafot on Eruvin 11a:6:1.english: A courtyard whose majority is entrances and windows - And [this refers to openings that are] less than ten [cubits wide]; for if [they were] more than ten [cubits], even where the standing [wall] is the majority, behold, Rav taught [Hiyya bar Rav]: "He must diminish [it]." And it is dealing with [a courtyard breached in] all four of its walls; for [if it were breached only] from two sides, Rav concedes that the form of a doorway is effective, as we said above: The halakhah is in accordance with the First Tanna. And [yet] it is difficult: for from this paradigm, one should derive that even [for] a fourth wall the form of a doorway should not be effective, just as it is not effective for [an opening] wider than ten [cubits] even in a single wall! And it can be answered that one can only derive [this rule] regarding four walls, for a single wall with [an opening] wider than ten [cubits] is equivalent to [being] mostly breached in all four walls: for the reason that [an opening] wider than ten [cubits] renders it prohibited is that it is not called an entrance, and [therefore] the form of a doorway is not effective for it; likewise, for [a courtyard that is] mostly breached on all four sides, the form of a doorway will not be effective, because people do not make entrances on all four sides; however, on a single wall, where people do make an entrance, it is obvious that the form of a doorway is effective, and concerning this it is not applicable to derive.

Tosafot on Eruvin 11a:7:1.hebrew: מה יתר מעשר האוסר במבוי - ואין להקשות: מה למבוי, שכן פרצתו בד'; דיתר מעשר נמי אסר בחצר, ולא נקט מבוי אלא משום דרב איירי ביה:
Tosafot on Eruvin 11a:7:1.english: Just as more than ten [cubits] that prohibits in an alleyway - And one should not raise the objection: What [comparison can be drawn from] an alleyway, seeing that its breach is [prohibited] at four [cubits]? For [an opening of] more than ten [cubits] also prohibits in a courtyard, and [the Gemara] mentioned an alleyway only because Rav was dealing with it.
